name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.199
notes: Fixed a race condition where opening or refreshing the app right at a fluid event's due time could silently cancel that event's push reminder before it fired.

The app now keeps treating the current fluid event as due for a short grace window after its nominal time before advancing to the next one, so it no longer resyncs the push server with a later time mid-fire.
Confirmed working via live server-side log monitoring and a real push notification received on iPhone.
label: FluidPushRaceFix
summary: Fixes a timing race that could silently cancel a fluid reminder push notification if the app was open right when the reminder was due.
whatsNew: Fluid reminder push notifications are now reliable even when the app is open and refreshing near a scheduled event's due time.
fixes: Race condition: dashboard render at an event's due moment advanced to the next event and overwrote (canceled) the pending push alarm before it fired. Fixed with a 2-minute grace window before advancing.
changes: nextFluidEvt selection logic in the main dashboard render now uses a grace window (eMins > nowMins - 2) instead of a hard cutover at the exact due minute.
No unrelated CardiacLens behavior was intentionally changed.
testing: Verified live via wrangler tail: alarm fired correctly and push notification was received on iPhone with app closed.
Race condition reproduced and root-caused via live log inspection before this fix.
Recommended follow-up test: keep using the app normally (opening/checking it) near a scheduled event's due time and confirm the notification still arrives.
